# Forbidden-path tripwire: agent-machinery paths that must never reappear.
#
# Each non-comment line is an extended regex matched CASE-INSENSITIVELY against
# every tracked path (git ls-files). A match fails the build even if the file is
# empty, because the PATH itself is the regression, not its content. This is the
# scan the content grep could not do. The two workflow patterns allow .yml or
# .yaml (GitHub accepts both); the other single-name files are matched exactly.

^agent/
^functions/
(^|/)scout\.ya?ml$
(^|/)reviewer\.ya?ml$
(^|/)scout-prompt\.md$
(^|/)reviewer-prompt\.md$
(^|/)SKILLS\.md$
(^|/)projects-context\.md$
(^|/)sources\.yaml$
(^|/)agent-ci-settings\.json$
(^|/)AGENT\.md$
